rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something secured in place or set and not expected to change.

example.english: This table is fixed to the wall.
example.traditional: 呢張枱係固定喺牆上面嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 hai6 gu3 ding6 hai2 coeng4 soeng6 min6 ge3

rows.note: Use this for something that has been repaired, corrected, or put right.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 zing2 hou2 bou6 laang5 hei3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when a person or thing is stuck and unable to move.

example.english: The car is fixed in the mud and can't move.
example.traditional: 部車卡咗喺泥度，郁唔到。
example.jyutping: bou6 ce1 kaat1 zo2 hai2 nai4 dou6 juk1 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this when an outcome, especially a contest result, has been secretly decided in advance.

example.english: The winner was fixed in advance.
example.jyutping: go3 gun3 gwan1 jat1 zou2 zau6 noi6 ding6 zo2
